#EASA and @EUROCONTROL have teamed up to verify the accuracy of gate-to-gate CO2 emissions assessments, based on actual fuel burn. Accurate measurement of these emissions is important to monitor progress towards greater sustainability. A joint report details the validation exercise that was carried out by EUROCONTROL and EASA with the contribution of Spain’s @Vueling airline, leveraging the capabilities of EASA’s “big data” Data4Safety Digital Platform.
